question: On the Agent CLI Getting Started page, what are the seven skill IDs the CLI bundles and what does each one teach the coding agent?
expected_answer: The Getting Started page shows that Agents CLI bundles seven skills covering the full ADK lifecycle. The skill IDs and what each teaches are: google-agents-cli-workflow (development lifecycle, code preservation, model selection); google-agents-cli-adk-code (ADK Python API — agents, tools, orchestration, callbacks); google-agents-cli-scaffold (project scaffolding — create, enhance, upgrade); google-agents-cli-eval (evaluation — metrics, evalsets, LLM-as-judge); google-agents-cli-deploy (deployment — Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, GKE, CI/CD); google-agents-cli-publish (Gemini Enterprise registration); google-agents-cli-observability (Cloud Trace, logging, third-party integrations).
expected_claims: The page shows seven skills bundled by Agents CLI.
google-agents-cli-workflow covers development lifecycle, code preservation, and model selection.
google-agents-cli-adk-code covers the ADK Python API — agents, tools, orchestration, and callbacks.
google-agents-cli-scaffold covers project scaffolding — create, enhance, upgrade.
google-agents-cli-eval covers evaluation — metrics, evalsets, LLM-as-judge.
google-agents-cli-deploy covers deployment — Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, GKE, CI/CD.
google-agents-cli-observability covers Cloud Trace, logging, and third-party integrations.

question: On the ADK Resume stopped agents page, what is the exact code shown for adding resumable configuration to an ADK app?
expected_answer: The docs page shows an Add resumable configuration section with a Python code block that constructs an App and wires resumability via a ResumabilityConfig object. The code is: app = App(name='my_resumable_agent', root_agent=root_agent, resumability_config=ResumabilityConfig(is_resumable=True)). The accompanying prose says to enable the Resume function by applying a Resumability configuration to the App object of your ADK workflow.
expected_claims: The page section is titled 'Add resumable configuration'.
The shown App constructor uses name='my_resumable_agent'.
The shown App constructor passes root_agent=root_agent.
Resumability is configured by passing resumability_config=ResumabilityConfig(is_resumable=True) to the App constructor.
The configuration is applied to the App object of the ADK workflow.

question: On the ADK Resume stopped agents docs page, what ADK Python version supports the Resume feature, and what caution does the page raise about it?
expected_answer: The page header carries a 'Supported in ADK: Python v1.16' badge and the body says that in ADK Python 1.16 and higher you can configure an ADK workflow to be resumable. The page also shows a yellow Caution callout titled 'Long Running Functions, Confirmations, Authentication' warning that for agents using Long Running Functions, Confirmations, or Authentication that require user input, adding a resumable confirmation changes how those features operate. The breadcrumb shows Home > Run Agents > Agent Runtime > Resume stopped agents.
expected_claims: The Resume feature requires ADK Python version 1.16 or higher.
The page surfaces a Caution callout titled 'Long Running Functions, Confirmations, Authentication'.
The caution warns that adding a resumable confirmation changes how Long Running Functions, Confirmations, and Authentication features operate when they require user input.
The page is reached via the breadcrumb Home > Run Agents > Agent Runtime > Resume stopped agents.
